```{r include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

The bar charts below display the mean observed peripheral parasite stage distribution in the AQUAMAT and SEAQUAMAT severe malaria datasets, separately for patients who survived and died.

In both studies, patients who died show a greater mean proportion of mature parasite stages and a smaller mean proportion of early parasite stages than patients who survived.

```{r load = FALSE}
library(data.table)
DATA_FILE <- "Data/dat_all.csv"
dat_all <- fread(DATA_FILE)
```

```{r store = FALSE}
# Stage variables used in this figure
stage_cols <- c("tring", "sring", "lring", "etroph", "mtroph", "ltroph", "schizont")
```

```{r prep = FALSE}
# Prepare data frame for bar charts
prep_stage_dist <- function(my_dataset, my_trial) {

  # Keep only variables required for this graph
  d <- my_dataset[Trial == my_trial, c("outcome", stage_cols), with = FALSE]

  # Complete cases only for variables used here
  d <- d[complete.cases(d)]

  # Calculate total number of staged cells
  d[, total_stage := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = stage_cols]

  # Keep the staging range used throughout the modelling work
  d <- d[total_stage >= 93 & total_stage <= 107]

  # Convert each patient's stage counts to proportions
  d[, (stage_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {x / total_stage}), .SDcols = stage_cols]

  # Convert outcome to labels
  d[, Key := ifelse(outcome == 1, "Deaths", "Survivors")]

  # Calculate group means
  stage_dist <- d[, lapply(.SD, mean), by = Key, .SDcols = stage_cols]

  # Put stages into plotting format
  reshape <- melt(stage_dist, id.vars = "Key", variable.name = "Stage",
                  value.name = "Percentage")

  # Add readable stage labels
  reshape[, Stage := factor(Stage, levels = stage_cols,
                            labels = c("Tiny rings", "Small rings", "Large rings",
                                       "Early troph.", "Mid troph.", "Late troph.",
                                       "Schizonts"))]

  reshape[, Key := factor(Key, levels = c("Survivors", "Deaths"))]
  return(list(data = reshape, n = nrow(d)))
}

# Apply to AQUAMAT & SEAQUAMAT in turn
AQ_result <- prep_stage_dist(dat_all, "AQUAMAT")
SQ_result <- prep_stage_dist(dat_all, "SEAQUAMAT")

AQ_reshape <- AQ_result$data
AQ_n <- AQ_result$n

SQ_reshape <- SQ_result$data
SQ_n <- SQ_result$n
```


```{r bar, echo = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# State IDDO colours
AQ_col <- c("#E31B23", "#7A3B7B")
SQ_col <- c("#E37210", "#1481E7")

# Plot stage distributions without internal titles
plot_bar <- function(my_reshape, my_col) {

  plot <- ggplot(my_reshape, aes(x = Stage, y = Percentage, fill = Key)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Survivors" = my_col[1], "Deaths" = my_col[2]),
                      name = NULL) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1),
                       limits = c(0, 0.51), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean peripheral stage proportion (%)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 35, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
          legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8))

  print(plot)
}

# AQUAMAT
plot_bar(AQ_reshape, AQ_col)

# SEAQUAMAT
plot_bar(SQ_reshape, SQ_col)
```
